primary.title: Received gratuity money after leaving your job? Experts explain the tax-free limit; when you may have to pay income tax
primary.summary: Received gratuity after resignation or retirement? The tax-free limit for most private-sector employees is ₹20 lakh, but the entire payout may not be exempt. Know how gratuity tax is calculated, eligibility rules and when income tax applies.
